verdict.rationale: cubic's docs say every PR is scanned for logic errors, style inconsistencies and potential security vulnerabilities, so security findings sit alongside functional bugs (cubic-docs-47, cubic-docs-19). Ultrareview is positioned for security-sensitive changes (cubic-docs-3, cubic-docs-48), and codebase scans hunt for vulnerabilities repo-wide (cubic-docs-12). However, security coverage is only a generic claim, with no specifics on the story's named categories. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of injection-risk detection, leaked-secret detection, and insecure-pattern categories in the diff, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of security-finding accuracy.
